eyebrow: A portal on the art and science of the senses — with a focus on pain
title: Modulation
intro: In neuroscience, the word for treating pain is *modulating* it. In painting and in music, modulation is the blending of rough edges, the synthesis of tone into harmony. One word, three fields — and the spine of this portal.
dial_hint: Drag — art and science are one object at two settings · arrows for another pair

pairs.felt_caption: A painting tries to catch what pain *is like* from the inside.
pairs.measured_caption: The same territory, measured: fluorescence-labelled neurons in a mouse spinal cord section — a micrograph from the lab.
pairs.credit: Left — painting, Asmita Sarkar · Right — fluorescence micrograph, Barik Lab, IISc

pairs.felt_caption: Here the artist reworks a real circuit into something closer to feeling — bloom, spark, a private landscape.
pairs.measured_caption: The same circuit, measured: Grpr+ neurons in the parabrachial nucleus, unedited.
pairs.credit: Left — digital work, Asmita Sarkar · Right — fluorescence micrograph, Barik Lab, IISc

quote: The paintings try to catch the experience of pain rather than accurately illustrating any scientific process.
quote_source: Exhibition note — Asmita Sarkar & Arnab Barik
